name: Besun Cafe Bakery

location.address: No. 37, corner of Davood Rashidi St, below Farhang Sq, Saadat Abad, Tehran

media.alt: Real photo from Besun Cafe Bakery's Instagram

description: A bakery-cafe whose feed reads 'blooming with positivity': bright patisserie cases, proper espresso, fresh pastries baked in-house. Calmer than the boulevard, great for a mid-morning stop or low-key date. Small and popular, so weekends get cozy-cramped. Open 7:30-23:00.
